# Hanzi Writer

- Library: [chanind/hanzi-writer](https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer) v3.7.3
- Stroke data: [chanind/hanzi-writer-data](https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data) / [Make Me a Hanzi](https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi)
- License: MIT（見 `LICENSE`）
- Used locally so the writing demo stays offline-friendly and does not call a CDN.
- Demo characters 「星」「月」use the same traditional/simplified glyphs.
- Family-name stroke paths in `data/hanzi-family-names.js` are from `hanzi-writer-data` 2.0.1 / Make Me a Hanzi; the underlying glyph graphics use the Arphic Public License in `ARPHICPL.txt`.
